notes: Feature article that is mostly about other fighters (Tom Kelly, Corbett, Fitzsimmons, Maher, Choynski); only Allen claims are kept. The start year is printed as 1880 here, and the hint's 1860 is not in the text. The 1867 excerpt for the bout date does not name Goss; the name comes from the preceding paragraph ('the celebrated bout between Ailen and Joe Goss').
